headline: Two proposals for the Huntress Fund, plus updates on the Fernald, Powers, and Clough funds.
summary: Current fund balances and the size and location of the Huntress Fund will be reviewed. A status report covers six funds with approved payments and an ornamental tree fund moved to DPW, and next steps are planned if the City Treasurer does not pay approved funds.
items: Review of current fund balances and the Huntress Fund's size and location
Status of six funds with payments approved since January 2026 or earlier
Ornamental tree fund transferred to DPW
Status of Powers and Clough funds, with School Committee and DPW
Next steps for the Fernald Fund with the Attorney General's office
Discussion of two proposals received for the Huntress Fund
Next steps if the City Treasurer fails to pay approved funds
location: Gloucester City Hall, 9 Dale Ave, 1ST FLOOR CONFERENCE ROOM, Gloucester, MA 01930
